assets.prompt: Create a game asset: one horizontal continuous packed BROWN EARTH WALL segment, top-down slight front depth, 3:1 wide strip. Same chunky crisp pixel art pixel size and dark outlines as reference spider, but ONLY soil: dark chocolate and warm umber compacted clods, small stones and a few thin embedded roots. Solid irregular rectangular wall mass with shallow jagged organic edges, continuous across full width, NOT spikes, not mountains, not crystals, not marble, no grass, no background, no text. Transparent around the wall. Suitable repeated horizontally and rotated vertically as solid game wall.

Edit reference trophy into ALL SEVEN WORLDS HARDCORE completion trophy. Preserve same silhouette scale, chunky pixel-art style, seven gemstones and gold pedestal. Change central white spider to dark obsidian spider with fiery red eyes, change white enclosing wreath to dark red and glowing orange flame-shaped wreath. Keep all seven different colored gems in gold settings. Strong dark crimson / orange palette unmistakably hardcore. Transparent background, no text, full trophy isolated.
